notes: A new version of NovelOS is available. Download the latest version from https://novelos.studio/downloads and install it manually.
release_notes:
## New

- **Sync your books.** Connect Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, iCloud Drive or WebDAV to keep your books the same on every device.
- **Export to the cloud.** Send an exported book or audiobook straight to Dropbox, Google Drive or OneDrive.
- **Command palette.** Press Cmd/Ctrl+K to jump to any chapter, character, place or command.
- **Move to…** Move a chapter anywhere in your book, drag chapters across levels, or select several at once.
- **Import into a new book.** Smart Import can start a new book from a file, and Undo import takes an import back.
- **Scenes.** See the scenes of the open chapter, jump to one, and add a Scene Break with Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Enter.
- **Voices and samples.** Pick a Read Aloud voice and speed after hearing a sample, on desktop and phone.
- **ElevenLabs narration.** Use your own ElevenLabs voices for Read Aloud and audiobooks, in many languages.

## Improved

- **Read Aloud.** Long chapters play to the end without stopping, and a chapter you have heard replays at once.
- **First-line indent.** Choose None, Short or Standard, the way printed books indent paragraphs.
- **AI tools.** Claude Code and other AI tools can work with more of your book, and every change can be undone.
- **Clearer AI errors.** Muse says which service failed and why, for example no credit left or a wrong key.

## Fixed

- Phone read-aloud could stop after one sentence.
- Read Aloud used a lot of memory and could stop halfway through a chapter.
- Smart Import could drop a Part heading next to short chapters.
- A Part page in exported PDFs could print "No content".
- Smart quotes could break EPUB and other exports.
- Checked boxes looked empty in dark mode.
- On Windows, AltGr keys did not type their characters.
- The status bar could show the previous book's chapter stats.

## Good to know

- Sync needs NovelOS Studio 1.5.0 on every device.
- Keep your Sync recovery key somewhere safe. It is the only way back into your synced books if you forget your passphrase.
- ElevenLabs voices need your own ElevenLabs account. The voices on your device stay free and private.
- From 1.5.1 on, NovelOS updates itself after you agree to restart. Install 1.5.0 by hand as usual.
